result.title: Stable and Calibrated Latent Force ODE Filters
result.comment: 21 pages, 10 figures. Code available at https://github.com/paufisch/lfcal
result.summary: Estimating unobserved forces in mechanistic systems is a central task of scientific machine learning. Approximate Gaussian filtering methods that synthesize mechanistic and empirical information have shown remarkable capacity in jointly identifying latent processes together with the system state in a single forward-backward pass. The resulting latent force ODE filter framework channels information from observational data specifically into the unknown parts of the system. This work addresses open questions about calibration and stability of the method. We show that the joint posterior over state and force is the reweighted conventional latent force posterior. This uncovers a crucial dependence of the stability of the method on the prior variance of the system state, which effectively controls the flow of information from observations to the latent force through the mechanistic system. From this insight, we construct an improved algorithm that provides stable and calibrated plug-and-play inference. We demonstrate the improved framework on several simulated experimental settings.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究潜变量力 ODE 高斯滤波器的校准与稳定性，证明状态与力的联合后验等价于加权后的常规潜变量力后验，并据此提出更稳定的 plug-and-play 推断算法，在模拟实验中验证。
